# Getting help

- **Usage questions and ideas:** open a GitHub issue using the feature request template, or start from [docs/getting-started.md](../docs/getting-started.md) and the [self-hosting guides](../docs/self-hosting/production.md).
- **Bugs:** open an issue with the bug report template (include version from `GET /api/status`, logs with secrets removed).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** do not open a public issue; use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/JerrettDavis/FlowLedger/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

FlowLedger is community supported on a best-effort basis; there is no commercial support or SLA.
